entries.notes: Ercolani: 'patacca, sm. agg. minchione, sciocco', pl. patéca. The mode name. Popular web adds the nuance of the harmless braggart (low reliability). Writing: pataca (single c) in modern use; patacca in Ercolani.
Ercolani (entry spatachéss) notes that 'pataca' also names female genitalia; Wiktionary lists the vulgar sense for Italian 'patacca'. Do not use casually.
